headline_pain: What If Rates Drop After You Buy?
primary_text: "Interest rates make me nervous about committing to a purchase right now." What if the timing actually works in your favour? Off-the-plan means you pay a deposit now but don't need finance until settlement — typically 12–18 months away. Economists are forecasting rate cuts in that window. You could lock in today's property price and settle at tomorrow's lower rate. That's the off-the-plan advantage. New warehouses in Truganina, 20km from Melbourne CBD, Princes Freeway access. Built for owner-occupiers. Ask us for a rate scenario comparison — no obligation.
description: Deposit now at today's price, settle later at potentially lower rates — best of both worlds.
